Live input reference

Controller & reaction preview

These are the controls and face plates running in this build. DualSense and Xbox One controllers use the same positional mapping; Controller 1 is Home and Controller 2 is Away.

Core controls

LSMoveDirection and dribbling
R2/RTSprintAnalogue sprint trigger
×/APassHold for pass power
○/BShoot / tackleDouble-tap shot for low driven; rapid taps while defending pull a shirt
□/XLob / slideLob in possession, slide without it
△/YThrough passLead the receiver into space
L1/LBSwitchChange controlled player
R1/RBShirt pullHold while chasing at close range
D↓DiveContextual dive; D-pad Down supports Firefox DualSense and Xbox standard layouts
R3/RSFlick upPop the ball up in the left-stick direction
L3+R3/LS+RSFightReact during the short post-card window
OPTIONS/MENUPauseOpen match controls and settings

FIFA-style skill gestures · restored

Step-overRS ↑ ↻ →  or  RS ↑ ↺ ←Start the right stick up, rotate a quarter-circle to either side, then release. The leading leg lifts and sweeps over the ball before the exit touch.
RouletteRS ↓ ↻ ←  or  RS ↓ ↺ →Start the right stick down, rotate a half-circle around either side, then release. The player shields the ball through a full body rotation.

Dive performances · D-pad Down triggers one contextual performance

SubtleSmall contact sell, short drop, controlled recovery.
FlopLegs give way and the body stays down long enough to read.
Ridiculous rollFull theatrical launch, repeated rolling and exaggerated travel.
